subject.title: Replacement for accidentally closed #3102: ClawScan backend error persists despite clean VirusTotal

question: Can either existing artifact-bound ClawScan job be safely resumed, or must a fresh complete scan run before any security result is written back?
rationale: VirusTotal telemetry is non-authoritative, and only production diagnostics can establish whether the failed jobs retain trustworthy inputs and worker provenance.

options.title: Inspect and resume existing job
options.body: Verify the artifact digest and persisted job inputs, then resume an existing scan if its provenance and intermediate state are intact.

options.title: Run a fresh complete scan
options.body: Start a new artifact-bound scan when the failed jobs cannot be safely resumed or their persisted state is incomplete.

options.title: Retain the error state
options.body: Keep the artifact fail-closed if neither an existing job nor a fresh scan can produce a trustworthy final result.

recommendation.title: Inspect and resume existing job
recommendation.body: Verify the artifact digest and persisted job inputs, then resume an existing scan if its provenance and intermediate state are intact.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature history and the issue’s explicit routing both connect this person to the VirusTotal and ClawScan pipeline.
